name: Visa de Séjour (Student/Intern Category)

qualifying_event.description: A student or intern applies for the same 'visa de séjour' instrument as other visitors, submitting a student enrollment certificate (or, for minors, parental authorization) as the purpose-specific supporting document.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Student enrollment certificate from a Chadian institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Student enrollment certificate from a Chadian educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to a Chadian educational institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Parental authorization is required for minor applicants.

outcome.duration_length: 1 month (single entry) or 3 months (multiple entries), renewable for the duration of study though not explicitly confirmed

sources.title: Embassy of Chad in Paris (official Chadian diplomatic mission) -- visa information sheet: student/intern category of the 'visa de séjour', requiring an enrollment certificate; same 1-month/3-month, EUR 70/100 fee structure as other purposes

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Chad). STATUS: DRAFT -- thin, and structurally the same underlying visa as td_visitor_visa.json (see that file's notes on Chad not running distinct visa-category instruments). Whether student status renews beyond the standard 1-3 month terms for the full duration of a multi-year program was not confirmed in this pass -- 'renewable' is set true as the logical/practical necessity for any multi-year student to remain, but the exact renewal mechanism and any distinct 'carte de séjour étudiant' beyond the entry visa were not found and are not assumed to exist as a separate instrument.
